Monsters.Name: Basilisk

SpecialAttacks.Name: Petrifying Gaze
SpecialAttacks.Description: Any creature meeting its gaze must save or turn to stone.

Monsters.Other: If its gaze is reflected back at it in bright light, the basilisk can petrify itself; can see into astral and ethereal planes.

Monsters.Name: Carrion Crawler

SpecialAttacks.Name: Paralysis
SpecialAttacks.Description: Tentacles cause paralysis for 3–12 turns.

Monsters.Other: Climbs walls and ceilings; multiple tentacle hits require multiple saving throws.

SpecialAbilities.Description: Access to 1st–4th level spells.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Level 4 Cleric spells

SpecialAbilities.Description: Backstab on surprise from behind: +4 to hit; x3 damage at level 5-8.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Pick Pockets
SpecialAbilities.Description: Attempts to steal from a random party member (25% + 5% per Hit Die). On success, steals coins and/or an item, then the group flees (no XP for that group).

SpecialAbilities.Name: Assassination

Monsters.Name: Devil, Erinyes

SpecialAttacks.Name: Venomous Dagger
SpecialAttacks.Description: Magical venomous dagger causes painful wounds; victims must save vs. poison or faint for 1-6 rounds.

SpecialAttacks.Name: Rope of Entanglement
SpecialAttacks.Description: Carries a rope of entanglement to restrain fallen victims.

SpecialAttacks.Name: Cause Fear
SpecialAttacks.Description: Cause fear (as a fear wand)

SpecialAttacks.Name: Erinyes Fear
SpecialAttacks.Description: Anyone who sees an erinyes must save vs. wand or be affected by fear.

SpecialAttacks.Name: Summon Erinyes
SpecialAttacks.Description: Once per round may use one power: detect invisible, invisibility, or summon another erinyes (25% success).

SpecialDefenses.Name: Devil Traits
SpecialDefenses.Description: Can be harmed by ordinary weapons.

Monsters.Other: 7' tall; covered in barbs; extremely aggressive; serves higher devils as shock troops.

Monsters.Name: Djinni

Monsters.Name: Green Slime

SpecialAttacks.Name: Flesh Conversion
SpecialAttacks.Description: Drops from above and attaches to living flesh; in 1-4 rounds the victim becomes green slime (no resurrection possible).

SpecialAttacks.Name: Corrosion
SpecialAttacks.Description: Eats wood slowly (1 inch per hour) and metal quickly; plate armor is consumed in 3 rounds.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Immune to Weapons
SpecialDefenses.Description: Weapons do it no harm; it can be scraped off, excised, frozen or burned.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Green Slime Spell Reaction
SpecialDefenses.Description: Only fire, cold or Cure Disease harm it; other spells have no effect.

Monsters.Other: Larger patches gain +1 HD per additional 3 square feet.

Monsters.Name: Hydra 8 Heads
Monsters.Other: https://1eonline.info/1mm/hydra.htm

Monsters.Name: Jackalwere

SpecialAttacks.Name: Sleep Gaze
SpecialAttacks.Description: Gaze causes sleep on any unsuspecting creature that fails its save vs. magic.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Iron or Magic Weapons Required
SpecialDefenses.Description: Jackalwere can only be hit by iron or magical weapons.

Monsters.Other: Can assume human form; often uses human weapons; 20% chance to be accompanied by normal jackals.

Monsters.Name: Lammasu

SpecialAttacks.Name: Level 4 Cleric spells
SpecialAttacks.Description: Can use clerical spells up to 4th level at 6th‑level proficiency.

Monsters.Other: Can become invisible and dimension door at will; 10% can speak holy word; aerial combat class C.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Lycanthropy
SpecialAbilities.Description: Can shift between human and bear‑hybrid form.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Silver or Magic Weapons Required
SpecialDefenses.Description: Can only be hit by silver or magical weapons.

Monsters.Name: Lycanthrope Weretiger

SpecialAttacks.Name: Rake
SpecialAttacks.Description: If both claws hit, weretiger rakes for 2–5/2–5 additional damage.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Silver or Magic Weapons Required
SpecialDefenses.Description: Weretigers can only be hit by silver or magical weapons.

Monsters.Other: Weretigers are solitary and territorial; can assume human, tiger, or hybrid form.

SpecialAttacks.Name: Tail Spikes
SpecialAttacks.Description: Fires volleys of 6 iron spikes (18" range, 1–6 damage each). Can fire 4 volleys.

Monsters.Name: Medusa

SpecialAttacks.Name: Medusa Gaze
SpecialAttacks.Description: Creatures within 3" who meet the gaze must save vs. petrification or turn to stone.

SpecialAttacks.Name: Poisonous Hair Asps
SpecialAttacks.Description: If the victim averts eyes, the medusa bites with asp‑hair; save vs. poison or die.

Monsters.Other: Gaze works on astral and ethereal creatures; reflected gaze turns the medusa to stone.

Monsters.Name: Brown Mold

SpecialAttacks.Name: Freezing Aura
SpecialAttacks.Description: Drains heat from creatures within 5 feet. Each melee round inflicts 1d8 cold damage for every 10 degrees of body heat above 55 degrees.

SpecialAttacks.Name: Heat-Fed Growth
SpecialAttacks.Description: Exposure to heat causes rapid expansion. Torches, flaming oil, and fire-based spells can increase its area by 2, 4, or 8 times.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Immune to Normal Attacks
SpecialDefenses.Description: Unaffected by non-magical attacks.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Affected Only by Magical Cold
SpecialDefenses.Description: Only magical cold has a significant effect on brown mold.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Dormancy
SpecialDefenses.Description: Cold causes the mold to become dormant for 5-30 turns.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Cold Creature Immunity
SpecialDefenses.Description: Its draining effect does not harm creatures that naturally use or embody cold.

Monsters.Other: Brown mold feeds on radiant energy and body heat rather than light. It is not affected by light spells or faerie fire. White dragon breath or a wand of cold will kill it. Psionic Ability: Nil. Attack/Defense Modes: Nil.

Monsters.Name: Yellow Mold

SpecialAttacks.Name: Poison Spores
SpecialAttacks.Description: Disturbing the mold releases deadly spores; inhalation can be fatal.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Affected only by fire based attacks
SpecialDefenses.Description: Can only be harmed by fire-based attacks.

Monsters.Other: Yellow mold grows in patches and is extremely dangerous when disturbed.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Slept
SpecialAbilities.Description: Can be affected by sleep effects.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Run
SpecialAbilities.Description: May flee from combat.

Monsters.Name: Otyugh

SpecialAttacks.Name: Disease
SpecialAttacks.Description: A creature bitten has a 90% chance of being infected with disease (typhus).

SpecialDefenses.Name: Never Surprised
SpecialDefenses.Description: The eyestalk thrust above the offal prevents the otyugh from being surprised.

Monsters.Other: Omnivorous scavenger living in dung and rubbish; semi-telepathic; 90% of encounters are a single individual; no interest in treasure.

Monsters.Name: Rakshasa

SpecialAttacks.Name: Illusion and ESP
SpecialAttacks.Description: Uses ESP and creates the illusion of what its prey deems friendly, withholding attack until prey is off-guard.

SpecialAttacks.Name: Level 3 Magic-User spells
SpecialAttacks.Description: Casts magic-user spells up to 3rd level

SpecialAttacks.Name: Level 1 Cleric spells
SpecialAttacks.Description: Casts cleric spells of 1st level

SpecialDefenses.Name: Immune to Spells Below 8th Level
SpecialDefenses.Description: Not affected by spells under the 8th level.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Rakshasa Weapon Defense
SpecialDefenses.Description: Cannot be harmed by non-magical weapons; magical weapons below +3 do half damage; crossbow bolts blessed by a cleric kill it.

Monsters.Other: Evil spirits encased in flesh, fond of human meat. If more than one is found in its lair, the group is a male and one or more females.

Monsters.Name: Salamander

SpecialAttacks.Name: Heat
SpecialAttacks.Description: Each hit adds 1-6 points of heat damage; fire resistant creatures suffer no heat damage.

SpecialDefenses.Name: +1 or better weapons to hit
SpecialDefenses.Description: Affected only by magical weaponry, magical creatures, or creatures of great strength.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Immunity to fire and heat
SpecialDefenses.Description: Impervious to all fire-based attacks.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Immune to Sleep, Charm, and Hold
SpecialDefenses.Description: Sleep, charm, and hold spells are ineffective.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Cold Vulnerability
SpecialDefenses.Description: Cold based attacks cause an additional 1 point of damage per die.

Monsters.Other: Creatures of the elemental plane of fire; upper body AC 5, lower body AC 3. They hate cold and prefer temperatures of 300 degrees or more.

Monsters.Name: Phase Spider

SpecialAttacks.Name: Phase Spider Poison
SpecialAttacks.Description: Victim must save vs. poison at -2.

SpecialAttacks.Name: Webs
SpecialAttacks.Description: Webs are equal to those of giant spiders.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Phasing
SpecialDefenses.Description: Shifts out of phase when attacking or attacked, returning only to deliver its bite; impervious to nearly all attacks while out of phase. A phase door spell holds it in phase for 7 melee rounds.

Monsters.Other: Ambush predator; phases to strike and retreat; extremely dangerous due to poison and ethereal movement.

Monsters.Name: Troll

SpecialDefenses.Name: Regeneration (3 HP/round)
SpecialDefenses.Description: Regenerates 3 hit points per round; only fire or acid prevents regeneration.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Surprise Resistance
SpecialDefenses.Description: Surprised only on a roll of 1.

Monsters.Other: Voracious, cruel, and ugly-tempered; trolls are feared for their regenerative powers and ferocity.

SpecialAttacks.Name: Energy Drain
SpecialAttacks.Description: Target loses 1 level unless save vs death.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Undead Traits
SpecialDefenses.Description: Immune to charm, sleep, hold.

Monsters.Name: Wraith

SpecialAttacks.Name: Energy Drain
SpecialAttacks.Description: Touch drains 1 life level from the victim.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Silver or Magic Weapons Required
SpecialDefenses.Description: Wraiths can only be hit by silver or magical weapons.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Silver Weapons Half Damage
SpecialDefenses.Description: Silver weapons cause only half damage; magically enchanted weapons score full damage.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Limited Spell Immunity
SpecialDefenses.Description: Unaffected by sleep, charm, hold, or cold-based spells.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Poison & Paralysis Immunity
SpecialDefenses.Description: Immune to all poison and paralysis effects.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Holy Water and Raise Dead Vulnerability
SpecialDefenses.Description: Holy water causes 2-8 hit points of damage per vial that hits; a raise dead spell slays a wraith.

Monsters.Other: Semi‑material undead; can drain levels even through armor; often found in catacombs or ruined cities.

Monsters.Name: Wyvern

SpecialAttacks.Name: Deadly Poison
SpecialAttacks.Description: Victim must save or die; delivered by the tail stinger.

Monsters.Other: Aerial predator; clumsy flyer (MC E); extremely aggressive; tail can strike over its back to hit opponents.

Monsters.Name: Minotaur

SpecialDefenses.Name: Surprise Resistance
SpecialDefenses.Description: Surprised only on a roll of 1.

Monsters.Other: Can butt opponents 6' or taller (2–8 dmg) or bite shorter ones (1–4 dmg); typically wields huge axe or flail; tracks prey by scent; very aggressive and relentless.

Monsters.Name: Giant Poisonous Snake

SpecialAttacks.Name: Giant Poisonous Snake Poison
SpecialAttacks.Description: Victims take 3–18 damage even on a successful save.

Monsters.Other: Attack range is 8 feet (half the snake’s length).

Monsters.Name: Giant Crocodile
Monsters.Other: Giant crocodiles are 21–30 feet long and extremely dangerous ambush predators.

Monsters.Name: Giant Weasel

SpecialAttacks.Name: Blood Drain
SpecialAttacks.Description: Drains 2–12 hit points per round once latched on.

Monsters.Other: Aggressive predator; often used by humanoids as guard animals.

Monsters.Name: Giant Warrior Ant

SpecialAttacks.Name: Poison Sting
SpecialAttacks.Description: If the sting hits, victim must save vs. poison; success reduces damage to 1–4.

Monsters.Other: Warrior ants accompany worker ants; one warrior per five workers in lair.

Monsters.Name: Lycanthrope Werewolf

SpecialAttacks.Name: Surprise
SpecialAttacks.Description: Can surprise opponents on a roll of 1–3.

SpecialDefenses.Name: Silver or Magic Weapons Required
SpecialDefenses.Description: Werewolves can only be hit by silver or magical weapons.

Monsters.Other: Often found in swamps; wolfwere variant exists; highly territorial and predatory.
